mintAuthority.summary: EURCV Ethereum mint is restricted to SG-FORGE's immutable registrar EOA. The token is a UUPS SmartCoin V4 proxy: the immutable technical EOA executes upgrades only after the registrar has authorized the candidate implementation; there is no separate proxy-admin slot.

controls.label: EURCV SmartCoin registrar and direct minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530438, getOperators() returned this address as registrar and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified SmartCoin V4 source gates mint() with onlyAllowedMinter and uses the registrar as its immutable mint authority; no numeric token cap is imposed. The registrar must also authorize a proposed implementation before the technical operator can execute a UUPS upgrade.

controls.label: EURCV SmartCoin technical upgrade executor
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530438, getOperators() returned this address as technical operator and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified SmartCoin V4 source gates _authorizeUpgrade() with onlyTechnical and additionally requires consumeAuthorizeImplementation() for a candidate previously authorized by the registrar. The EIP-1967 implementation is 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b and the proxy-admin slot is zero.

sources.label: White & Case - SG-FORGE ACPR e-money institution licence for EURCV

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530438, getOperators() returned unchanged registrar, operations, and technical EOAs; version() returned V4, newImplementation() returned zero, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot returned 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b. Verified source establishes registrar-only minting and the registrar-authorization plus technical-execution UUPS upgrade sequence. XRPL, Stellar, and Solana remain separate issuer-operated deployments outside this Ethereum control review. SG-FORGE is an ACPR-authorised Electronic Money Institution and EURCV is structured as a MiCA electronic-money token, so the issuer is prudentially supervised. However SG-FORGE publishes only a self-reported daily 100%-collateral figure on its own website; no named independent accounting/verification firm attests EURCV reserves (the Hacken work is smart-contract-only and RWA.xyz lists no auditor), so supply is not independently reconciled and reconciliation is unknown. Under the rubric an unreconciled mint stays critical regardless of prudential supervision.

reserves.name: Euro cash deposits at Societe Generale

reserveReview.rationale: SG-FORGE's daily disclosure reports EUR CoinVertible reserves as 100% cash at Societe Generale, equal to EURCV in circulation. The issuer also states that CoinVertible is fully cash-backed with immediate liquidity, segregated collateral, and bankruptcy-remoteness protections.
